institution: DH.ARC, Università di Bologna, with Concordia University (Montréal) and CarisBo

notes: Digital genetic and annotated edition (EVT2) of Varchi's unfinished Storia fiorentina, left incomplete at his death in 1565 and printed only in 1721 in a censored form. Only the Proemio is published so far: the TEI file pilot_proemio.xml in the project's GitHub repository holds about 3,900 words (our own count of the body text); the whole work is not online. Status archived: the repository's last commit is 13 June 2021 and the site has had no update since. The licence is the Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 3.0 link shown on the home page.

title: Venetian Inscriptions in Cyprus (La Lettera e il Leone)
institution: Ca' Foscari University of Venice (Lorenzo Calvelli) and The Cyprus Institute (STARC)
license_note: Described as an Open Access platform; no licence statement found on the pages (footer: all rights reserved). Image credits are given per image.
notes: Open access platform of Latin Renaissance inscriptions from Venetian-ruled Cyprus (1474-1571) with interpreted and diplomatic transcriptions, English and Italian translations, apparatus and photos; no login needed (the LogIn link is for editors). 27 inscriptions in total on 17 sites: 24 are dated within or overlapping 1450-1700 (15 with numeric years, 9 with approximate dates such as 'end of the 15th century'), 1 is Janus I's epitaph of 1432, 2 are illegible fragments with 'Uncertain' dates. words = word-like tokens of the interpreted transcriptions of the 24 (our own count by crawling the 27 inscription pages; approximate). No bulk download or TEI export found. Pages modified as late as September 2024. Related: the Titulus/ERC GRAPH-EAST corpus covers Cyprus (575 texts) but is not yet published online.
